It sounds like you and your family are going through a really confusing and stressful time. While it can sometimes feel like extreme mood swings are just a way to get attention, the shifts you are describing—going from highly excited and active to very down and depressed—can actually be signs of a real, underlying health or mental health condition. It is very possible that she is not doing this on purpose and is struggling to manage these intense changes herself.

Because this is affecting her and your whole family, it would be incredibly helpful for her to see a doctor or a mental health professional. A professional can provide a proper evaluation and help figure out exactly what is going on. Try to approach the situation with patience, and gently encourage her to speak with a healthcare provider. Remember that it is also important to take care of your own well-being and seek support for yourself while navigating this family stress.
